news.comment: Coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that the Vikings expect Hockenson (wrist/chest) to make progress ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.
Eboigbe (ankle) is inactive for Monday's game against the Ravens, Omar Navarro of the Chargers' official site reports.
Harrison (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant on Monday's practice report.
Thompson (hamstring) is inactive for Monday night's game against the Ravens.
Mallory (hamstring) did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that he's hopeful that Tate (shoulder) will return to action in Week 11 versus the Cowboys, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.
Monangai (thumb/toe) said Monday that he's "on track" to return to action Sunday against the Saints, Courtney Cronin of ESPN reports.
Slovis (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Ravens' emergency No. 3 quarterback Monday night versus the Chargers.
Monangai (toe/thumb) was spotted working out during Monday's unofficial practice and is eyeing a return to action Sunday against the Saints, Chris Emma of 104.3 The Score Chicago reports.
Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that the 49ers are "hoping to" have Evans (Achilles) back at practice this week, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
Al-Shaair (groin) did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
Lane brought in three of 11 targets for 61 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
Bateman brought in three of five targets for 42 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
Harris secured all five targets for 86 yards in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.
Johnston brought in his sole target for six yards in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.
Andrews brought in all eight targets for 82 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
Herbert completed 12 of 18 passes for 129 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed seven times for 51 yards and a touchdown in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.
Watkins caught two passes for 49 yards on three targets in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.
Boutte failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
Brissett completed 33 of 49 passes for 340 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and added two rushes for two yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
Flowers brought in six of seven targets for 74 yards and lost a fumble in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
Bellinger caught two of three targets for six yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
Dike caught two passes for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars. He added five rushing yards on one attempt.
Jones tallied seven tackles (three solo) during Seattle's win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
Raridon caught his only target for six yards in Sunday's loss to the Lions.
Allen caught his lone target for a 19-yard touchdown in Sunday's win over the Cardinals.
Rivers rushed 15 times for 81 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
Atwell caught one of two targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
Daniels caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
Hampton rushed 22 times for 105 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of two targets for no gain in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night. He also fumbled once but recovered.
Tremble caught four of five targets for 48 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
Henry rushed 10 times for 10 yards and two touchdowns and brought in all five targets for 10 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
Dotson caught three passes for 63 yards on six targets in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs.
Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Monday that Tunsil (triceps) is progressing as anticipated and is ready to begin the strength portion of his recovery program, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.
Slye made all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also logged a tackle and forced a fumble.
Horton failed to garner a target during Sunday's 21-13 win over the Raiders.
Kupp hauled in his lone target for a 34-yard touchdown during the Seahawks' 21-13 win over the Raiders on Sunday.
Myers missed his sole field-goal attempt and made three PATs in the Seahawks' 21-13 win over the Raiders on Sunday.
James returned five kickoffs for 101 yards during the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday.
Pineiro made his only field-goal attempt and went 5-for-5 on PATs during Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.
Boswell made his sole field-goal attempt and sole PAT in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.
Sanders made all four of his field-goal attempts in the Jets' 31-12 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
Gipson was signed by the Giants off of Philadelphia's practice squad Monday, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.
Reichard made all three of his field-goal attempts and all three PATs in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers on Sunday.
Allen turned his lone carry into zero yards and hauled in his lone target for minus-4 yards during the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
Wright turned three carries into minus-2 yards, caught both of his targets for 17 yards and returned four kickoffs for 88 yards during the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
Biggers will undergo a season-ending knee surgery in the near future, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Higbee caught three of four targets for 17 yards and a touchdown during the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
McManus made both of his field-goal attempts and all four PATs in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
Pipkins (knee) won't be available for Monday's game against the Ravens after the Chargers didn't activate him from injured reserve.
Shelley (ankle) is questionable to return to Monday night's contest against the Ravens, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
Gay went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made his only PAT during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.

board.comment: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Wingard (wrist/hand) will be "out for an extended period of time," Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Burch (knee) will be sidelined for the rest of the 2026 season, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.
Madubuike (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday night's contest against the Chargers.
Ioane (shoulder) is questionable to return to Monday night's contest against the Chargers.
Benford (groin) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Jets.
Alford (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Jets.
Williams (calf) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jets.
The Bills did not activate Shavers (knee) from the reserve/PUP list, and he will not be available for Sunday's game against the Jets.
Monangai (thumb/toe) said Monday that he's "on track" to return to action Sunday against the Saints, Courtney Cronin of ESPN reports.
Burden (concussion) was spotted participating in the Bears' unofficial practice session Monday, AllCHGO.com reports.
Stevenson exited Sunday night's game against the Bucs with a hand injury and is questionable to return.
Risner (knee) will not return to Sunday night's game against the Steelers.
Burks (groin) will not return to Sunday night's game against the Steelers, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.
Bland sustained a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 46-40 loss to the 49ers, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
Booker suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 46-40 loss to the 49ers, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News  reports.
Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.
Moss (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

Tests have confirmed that Hutchinson suffered a torn ACL in his right knee during Sunday's win against the Patriots in Munich, but there's no other significant damage in the knee, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
Joseph (knee) did not travel to Munich with the Lions and is ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Patriots.
Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.
Cisse (ribs) is "fine" after exiting the Packers' Week 10 loss to the Vikings early, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

Head coach Matt LaFleur acknowledged that Parsons (knee/illness) could be ready to make his season debut following the Packers' Week 11 bye, but he still has "a couple more hurdles" to clear before being deemed ready to play, Ryan Wood of USA Today reports.
Moore's ankle injury is not considered serious, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
Al-Shaair (groin) did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
Harrison (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant on Monday's practice report.
Gould (toe) was estimated as limited in Monday's walkthrough practice.
Raimann has entered the league's concussion protocol and has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Dolphins, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
Colts head coach Shane Steichen reported Ward (shin) didn't return to Sunday's 24-22 win over the Dolphins and could miss Thursday's game versus Houston, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
Colts head coach Shane Steichen reported Gardner suffered a left calf injury during Sunday's 24-22 win over the Dolphins and may not play Thursday versus Houston, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.
Mallory (hamstring) did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
Striggow is being evaluated for a possible concussion and is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Titans.
Hainsey (knee) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Titans.
Wiley suffered a fractured ankle in the Chiefs' 35-13 victory over the Falcons on Sunday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.
Smith (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Falcons.

Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Monday that Bowers (ankle) is considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports. "It's not as bad as we thought, but still a significant injury," Kubiak said.
Paye (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
Thompson (hamstring) is inactive for Monday night's game against the Ravens.
Eboigbe (ankle) is inactive for Monday's game against the Ravens, Omar Navarro of the Chargers' official site reports.
Shelley (ankle) is questionable to return to Monday night's contest against the Ravens, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
Shelton (hamstring) is set to miss several weeks due to injury, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.
Meyer (stinger) is questionable to return to Sunday's matchup against Indianapolis.
Baker (knee) was not activated from the reserve/PUP list ahead of Sunday's clash against Indianapolis.
Phillips underwent further tests Monday on the arm he injured in Sunday's 24-22 loss to the Colts, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.
Biggers will undergo a season-ending knee surgery in the near future, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Van Ginkel (quadriceps) is expected to practice ahead of a Week 11 road matchup against the 49ers, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reported Monday.
Richter (foot) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Packers.
Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison will require surgery on his thumb and will miss a few weeks, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.
Coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that the Vikings expect Hockenson (wrist/chest) to make progress ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.
Brown (hamstring) was spotted walking around with a limp in the locker room following Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.

Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he didn't have a definitive diagnosis for the injury Maye (ankle) sustained in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, but indicated that the quarterback will miss time," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports.  "I wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the [Week 11] bye," Vrabel said.
Jones (cramps) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich.
Spillane (illness) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich.

Head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Richards will be sidelined for multiple weeks due to a knee injury that the latter sustained during the Saints' 20-17 loss to the Panthers on Sunday, Matthew Paras of The New Orleans Times-Picayune reports.
Werner (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Jeff Nowak of WWL Radio reports.
Pinnock (back) is questionable to return to Thursday night's contest against the Commanders, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

Head coach Aaron Glenn told reporters that Parham got imaging done for a knee injury that the latter sustained during the Jets' Week 10 loss to the Bills on Sunday, Eric Allen of the Jets' official site reports.
Smith (ankle) underwent tests Monday that did not reveal any major injuries, but he will continue to be evaluated during the week, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Cooper (ankle) will undergo imaging Monday, Eric Allen of the team's official site reports.
Baun (back) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against the Giants.
McCormick (ankle) suffered a significant injury during the Steelers' Week 10 loss to the Bengals, Brian Batko of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that the 49ers are "hoping to" have Evans (Achilles) back at practice this week, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
Green (back) was unable to finish Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys, Jennifer Lee Chan of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
Lucas (ankle) is doubtful to return to Sunday's game against the Raiders.
Holani is week-to-week after suffering an MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Las Vegas, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday.
Reed is doubtful to return to Sunday's game against Las Vegas due to a toe injury.

Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
Winfield (ankle) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday night's contest against the Bears.

Mayfield's availability for next Sunday's game against the Lions is in question due to an injury he sustained to his foot and ankle area during the Buccaneers' Week 9 loss to the Bears, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that he's hopeful that Tate (shoulder) will return to action in Week 11 versus the Cowboys, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.
Adams has entered the league's concussion protocol and has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
Robinson is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jaguars due to an ankle injury.
